hypotheses.title: Residual-bank compression under explicit hardware and quality budgets

hypotheses.falsifier: Rare-information loss, training regression, or dequantization/backward/communication costs erase the practical benefit.

hypotheses.falsifier: Full-harness tests already satisfy the remaining contracts without consequential failures, or the controlled assumptions fail under real providers, concurrent writers, torn storage or external-effect receipts.
hypotheses.next_gate: Full-harness Windows readiness remains unmet. Retain actual upstream process-fixture acceptance gates: original-session progress, stale identity rejection, full-turn checkpoint retention beyond20messages, completed-policy settlement without duplicate work, restrictions through CLI fallback/queues, current operator/device/role revocation and second restart. Preserve173454 requested-kill/pre-settlement crash window with independent PID/effect/SQLite/notice receipts and persistence-failure controls. These are deferred integration requirements, not new executed experiments. The single proposed next complete-harness experiment this pass is the pinned Pi/ACP replay gate in H4; helper/context success, author counts and CI metadata alone clear neither project gate.
hypotheses.alternative_explanation: These changes may be routine repair of already known integration bugs, without establishing a new research program or any individual private plan.
